messages:
Harper Nguyen: Hi all! First day on Data Platform 389 Remote in PDX. Quick Qs: 1) Mac vs Linux devbox? 2) VPN setup for Portland (any region quirks?), 3) how to get SSH + repo access? Also small intro: I bake sourdough and rescue plants 338

Olivia (IT): Welcome Harper! For data infra folks we usually ship Mac M2s but Linux is fine if you'd prefer. DM your shipping address and I'll queue the order. For VPN we use WireGuard + Okta MFA; no region quirks for PDX. I'll DM a prebuilt wg config.

Marcus Lee: Hey Harper 44b I'm your buddy. For SSH: generate an ed25519 key and paste the pubkey at https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys, then request access to redwood/data-platform via the internal UI. Happy to pair on access at 2pm PT.

Harper Nguyen: 2pm PT works, thanks Marcus. I'll grab the SSH key now. Also stickers: are there plant stickers? Asking for my laptop 60a

Finn (People Ops): Hi Harper 60a Badge pickup: fill https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge and choose "HQ reception" when you're in SF. Onboarding emails sent to your personal inbox. Welcome lunch on Friday at 12pm if you're around. Also we have a small swag stash with plant stickers 338

Zoe K.: Welcome! Added you to #eng-data and #new-hires. We'll do a quick team intro at 10am PT tomorrow.

Olivia (IT): Mac M2 order placed (unless you switch). MDM enrollment for Mac:
```
open /Applications/RedwoodMDM/Enroll.app
# if blocked: sudo installer -pkg /tmp/RedwoodMDM.pkg -target /
```
If you hit any blocker paste the console output here and I'll triage.

BuddyBot: Harper Nguyen was added to #eng-data and #new-hires. :tada:
